While on their way to school, Josuke and Okuyasu find a young man lying unconscious in the middle of what appears to be a crop circle.  When they try to take a closer look, the man suddenly wakes up and starts claiming he's an alien from outer space.

Rohan is convinced that Josuke is cheating in their game of Cee-lo when all the dice rolls in his opponent's favor. Feeling insulted, Rohan stabs his own finger and swear he'll find out how Josuke is cheating in their next round.

Rohan sacrifices himself to save Josuke from a remote-controlled Stand that sucks nutrients out of its victims. Moved by Rohan's act of bravery, Josuke races through town to find and defeat the Stand's user before it can kill Rohan.

Shinobu tells her husband, Kosaku, that she saw a stray cat in their basement with a hole in its throat. When Kosaku goes down to take a look, he finds the cat already dead, The next morning, a strange plant sprouts from the spot where the cat was buried.

Yoshihiro Kira spots Kosaku Kawajiri and instantly recognizes that it's actually his son, Yoshikage. Meanwhile, Josuke, Okuyasu, and Mikitaka find a strange man living in an abandoned electrical tower.

Josuke enters the electrical tower again to save Mikitaka and defeat Toyohiro Kanedaichi. Meanwhile, Rohan receives a visit from a first-class architect named Masazo Kinoto, who's come to estimate the repair costs to his burnt house.

Rohan finds himself possessed by Masazo Kinoto's Stand, Cheap Trap, who tells the manga artist to burn the photos he took of the people in Morioh. Meanwhile, Josuke and Yuya encounter the Stand user responsible for Koichi's disappearance.
Rohan calls over Koichi to help him fight off Cheap Trap, which has attached itself onto Rohan's back. Unfortunately, Koichi thinks Rohan is pulling a prank on him and leaves.

Kosaku Kawajiri is forced to kill Hayato after the boy threatens to expose him as a killer.  To make matter worse, Kosaku learns from his father, Yoshihiro, that Rohan and the others are coming to investigate the Kawajiri family shortly.

Yoshikage Kira gains a new ability called Bites the Dust, a bomb that automatically kills anyone who tries to discover Kira's identity through Hayato. Realizing that the only people who could stop Kira are ones with similar powers.

Hayato's attempt to kill Kira using Stray Cat's air bullet ends in failure. Kira realizes that letting Hayato repeat the same morning is becoming a risk, so he decides to undo Bites the Dust after he sees through Rohan's death.
Josuke and Hayato hide inside a nearby residence to escape from Deadly Queen and Stray Cat's attack. But to their horror, Kira is somehow able to close in on them from outside the house.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they'll put Winchester's new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.
Capt. Jared Raskob joins the legendary offshore Capt. Scott Stoky for a day of fishing in Islamorada, Florida.

On opening day of Missouri's gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. For Nikki Boxler and the Winchester Deer Camp, it's no different. With Winchester's in hand, Nikki and crew play cat and mouse with several mature bucks at Indian Hill Outfitters in Pike County.

Every season, just like clockwork, mission-driven longboards gobble their way across the plains of South Dakota, the cornfields of Iowa, the timbered ridges of Michigan and the cattle ground of Kansas looking for their soulmates in one of the most celebrated hunting seasons in America…the wild turkey breeding season. Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

Capt. Justin Leake joins some old friends on board the Fall Line in hopes of scoring big in the Bay Point Billfish Open. This trip will test the limits of all the anglers as the skilled captain and crew do the impossible in hopes of bringing home the prize.
Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.

In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch' stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City.  In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
Hoss helps Charlie and Will (Charlotte and Willomina), two young girls who just lost their father.  They go on a journey to find their only nearby relative, Aunt Cloe.

In this sequel to "The Waiting Game", Laura resents Adam's advice on how she ought to be running her ranch.  A newcomer, Ward Bannister, comes to her aid, but is actually part of a scheme to steal her ranch.
In this entertaining episode, laced with humor, Hoss first meets mountain man Jim Leyton.  Bing Russell makes his first appearance as Deputy Clem Foster.
Adam, Hoss and Joe mistakenly believe their father was murdered.  They split into 3 different directions to confront the supposed killers.
Two Virginia City old-timers fool Hoss and Joe into raising rabbits, and the Ponderosa is overrun with paws and whiskers.
Boruto and Shinki manage to slip away from Urashiki, but escaping him completely proves to be difficult.
Urashiki is determined to get Shukaku's chakra and attacks ruthlessly. Boruto and Shinki form a united front and unleash each of their special jutsu
Boruto and Shinki bring Shukaku to Hidden Leaf Village. Upon arriving at the Uzumaki home, Himawari is completely taken with him.
Boruto becomes fascinated by Jiraiya, Naruto's former mentor.
Boruto is forbidden to participate in the counterattack on Urashiki because he was previously targeted by the Otsutsuki.

programmes.st: The Village Hidden in the Leaves
programmes.d: While chasing down Urashiki, Boruto and Sasuke get hit with a strange Otsutsuki weapon.
Boruto and Sasuke end up staying in the Hidden Leaf under the watchful eyes of Naruto and Jiraiya.

programmes.st: The Power of the Nine Tails
programmes.d: Urashiki appears to steal the chakra of Nine Tails from Naruto, but his attempt is unsuccessful.
At Jiraiya�s suggestion, Boruto and Naruto train to synchronize their chakra, but this turns out to be more difficult than expected.
Boruto and Naruto resume their training.

programmes.st: The Power to See the Future
programmes.d: Another intense battle begins for Boruto, Sasuke and Jiraiya as they try to defend Naruto from Urashiki
Boruto's quick thinking exposes Urashiki's trick that enables him to see into the future and they manage to inflict some damage
The battle against Urashiki is over, and it's time for Boruto and Sasuke to return to the place where they rightfully belong.
Sumire's wish comes true and she joins the Scientific Ninja Tools Team, leaving only Wasabi and Namida on Team 15
Boruto's grandfather Hiashi's birthday is approaching and there's going to be a small family celebration
Enko Onikuma hasn't been able to control her power, hindering her work on missions.

programmes.st: The Mind Transfer Jutsu that Lost to Potato Chips
programmes.d: Inojin approaches his parents about mastering the Mind Transfer Jutsu.
Boruto and Mitsuki are sent to Hozuki Castle to protect Kokuri, a former member of a brutal band of robbers.
Boruto and his team try to get Kokuri assigned to the same cell, but the warden, Benga, shuts the idea down.
A wooden tag used to prevent unauthorized entry into the medical unit has been stolen, and the prison guards begin a search for the culprit.
Boruto and the others can't help but feel that Kokuri is hiding something from them.
Boruto and Mitsuki worry that their mission is in jeopardy, since Kokuri is scheduled to be transferred to Hozuki Castle II.
The clock ticks down to the rendezvous time for the escape, but there's no word from Sarada. If they miss this chance, everything will be ruined
Boruto and his team fight desperately in order to protect Kokuri, but they're tormented by Tsukiyo's jutsu as time threatens to run out on their prison break!
Boruto meets Tento, the son of Ikkyu Madoka�the Feudal Lord of the Land of Fire�who�s in the Hidden Leaf for a meeting with the Hokage.
Boruto's new mission is to guard Tento, who is obsessed with ninja and collecting X Cards.

programmes.st: The Value of a Hidden Ace
programmes.d: Boruto is excited to start a new mission when he finds the rare X Card that he had wanted in his pocket. Realizing that this was from Tento, he goes to their hotel and learns that Tento's life is in danger.
Boruto rushes to save Tento, but Shojoji the leader of the Mujina Gang blocks his way.
A training class on Medical Ninjutsu is to be held, and each team must send a representative. Sarada is chosen for Team 7.
Tsubaki devises a plan to hone her team’s skills, where they fight for who performs best on missions.
Himawari attends the Ninja Academy's trial session where participants get a taste of ninja training.
Team 7 is assigned to back up the Leaf Police Force on a security mission. Their client is a president of a company who is being targeted by a serial killer known as \"The Rainy Day Killer.\"

programmes.d: After hearing thieves have been raiding deliveries of azuki beans, Cho-Cho plans to team up with Anko Mitarashi to capture the bandits!

A small community is shocked when a woman is shot and killed in a church.
Grissom is fascinated when every detail of a miniature is identical to that of a real crime scene, and he goes about trying to solve the case using the clues provided.

When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.
When a dead woman is found hanging from a cross inside a church, the team follows the evidence to uncover a bizarre love triangle dating all the way back to the victim's high school days.
When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.
While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.
Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.
When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.
The lead suspect for the high-profile murder of anti-drug crusading assemblyman Danilo Zamesca is Thomas Simon, the west coast's biggest drug supplier.

As Catherine and Keppler begin to investigate the murder of a teen-aged Jane Doe, both agree that the killer, who was meticulous in removing evidence from the body and its surrounding area, is likely a repeat offender.
A case involving a man's torched corpse whose bones and tissues had been harvested leads Nick and Keppler into the disturbing world of illegally sold human body parts.
Grissom returns from his teaching sabbatical as new member of the team, Michael Keppler desperately tries to keep his dark past hidden from his colleagues.

With potentially less than a day to attempt to prevent the next murders, the CSI team must quickly shake off their shock that the true miniature killer is not the late Ernie Edward Dell, who committed suicide after confessing to the slayings.
Grissom's quip that two missing young lovers may have run off to Mexico is soon quashed by the discovery of drops of blood by the boy's vacant parking spot at the high school.
While processing the house where several showgirls were murdered, Sara is haunted by the terrified eyes and cryptic dying words of the sixth victim she discovers.

Greg is forced to again contend with the hostile mother and brother of the hoodlum he killed in self-defense several months ago when the CSI team discovers that the brother is involved in a new murder case.
Megan Donner returns to the CSI unit in time to work on a jet crash in the Everglades. They discover a victim five miles from the crash.
After fishermen catch a tiger shark and discover a partial human torso in its stomach, evidence leads the team to suspect murder.
When a rape and a murder takes place on a Miami beach, Horatio and the team are sent to investigate the mansion of the Hamilton family.
When his mentor is killed while defusing a bomb, Horatio goes on a personal mission to find the culprit. Megan wonders if he is too close to the case.
When a priest is murdered, Horatio and the team must investigate. A lip print on a drinking glass sets a 12-year-old altar boy as a prime suspect.
A 5-year-old girl is murdered at a restaurant/playland catering to parents and children, and Horatio and the team must investigate.
Horatio and the team investigate the murder of a male stripper found dead after a female sex party. Evidence suggests he had sex prior to his death.

Paige finds herself transported back in time to an era of free love and free magic, where she discovers Grams, a peace-loving hippie, who is on a crusade to rid the world of evil through the magical power of love.

After Piper vanquishes a demon from Wyatt's room, she has an epiphany about the rest of her life concerning Wyatt. Unable to handle Piper's revelation, Paige and Phoebe decide to remind Piper of the importance of love by conjuring up a 'Mr. Right.'

Jason breaks up with Phoebe when he finally learns her and her sisters are really witches. Meanwhile, Richard attempts to free himself of his family's karma, and Piper and Paige try to vanquish a group of Swarm demons.
The Charmed Ones help out Leo's mentor, Gideon, when he wants to find out who cast the spell of darkness over a magic school and conjured the Headless Horseman who has been beheading the teachers.

When Phoebe frees a genie from a bottle, she soon finds that she must take the genie's place. Meanwhile, anxious to put Leo and Piper back together, Chris uses Phoebe to make his wish come true, but she takes his instructions too literally.
Gideon makes a deal with the Darklighters to get rid of Leo, but they accidentally send Leo and Piper to the Ghostly plane, leaving Phoebe and Paige to believe that they are both dead.

Phoebe accidentally casts a spell on herself that allows her wild teenage personality to take over, and teen Phoebe is eager to use her magic to her advantage. Meanwhile, Piper asks her father to find out why Chris is avoiding her.
When Piper is kidnapped and cocooned by the Spider Demon, and Chris becomes infected with the Demon's venom, causing him to mutate into a spider demon, Paige, Phoebe and Leo try to rescue them.
When Phoebe and Paige are caught on tape using their powers, the Cleaners, cover up the situation by implicating Darryl as a murderer. When the sisters try to help, they end up on trial instead.

programmes.st: A Wrong Day's Journey Into Right
programmes.d: With Piper away at magic school and Phoebe without her active powers, overworked Paige conjures Mr. Right for stress relief but, unknowingly, releases his evil twin, Mr. Wrong.

Under the pressure that the Halliwell sisters will discover his evil plot, Gideon conspires with two demons to make Piper, Phoebe and Paige part of 'Witch Wars', a new demonic reality television show.

programmes.st: It's A Bad, Bad, Bad, Bad World, Part 1 & 2
programmes.d: Gideon creates a portal that puts Chris and Leo in a mirrored world where evil prevails, and Phoebe and Paige travel to the parallel universe to rescue them. Meanwhile, Piper gives birth to baby Chris.

A grief-stricken Piper and Leo attend a Hindu wedding, where they inadvertently receive the powers of Hindu gods, and it's up to Phoebe and Paige to keep them from consummating their love in order to save the universe.

The Charmed Ones have their hands full, when thanks to a bored Magic School student, they must keep Lord Dyson from killing the infamous Lady Godiva before she can travel back in time and complete her famous ride.
When Paige and Phoebe summon Grams for Chris' Wiccaning, Grams puts a spell on the children to try to end their sibling rivalry, but instead it reverts the sisters back to bickering teenagers.

When Paige encounters Captain Black Jack Cutting, an 18th century pirate in search of the Fountain of Youth, the curse on his life becomes her problem. Meanwhile, Leslie manipulates a contest in order to spend time with Phoebe.

Coach feels he can't compete with Sam when they fall for the same woman.
Sam loans out his lucky cap to a baseball player who's in a slump.
Inebriated for the first time in his life, a timid young priest-to-be makes an amorous advance toward Diane and concludes he's not fit for the monastery.

A casting agent pursues Sam, offering more than just a business proposition.
Saddened by the death of her cat, Diane gains little sympathy from the Cheers clan and begins to reevaluate her relationships with everyone, especially Sam.
Diane is aghast when a very pregnant Carla tricks the surprised, but ecstatic egghead Marshall Lipton into believing he's the father.
Sam's shocked when his ex-teammate comes out of the closet at the bar.
Sam unknowingly hires and ex-murderer to escort Diane on a double date.
Sam enters a photo of Diane in the annual Miss Boston Barmaid contest.
Sam tries to set up a sting to catch a crooked poker player. When Sam learns that a conman has taken thousands of dollars from Coach, he turns to Harry "The Hat" to help them get the money back.
Diane proposes marriage to Sam in order to save her mom's inheritance.
Sam is chagrined when his brother captivates everyone at Cheers, especially Diane, whose budding romance with the dashing Derek sparks Sam's jealously and confusion.
Sam and Diane are forced to come to grips with their feelings about each other when Diane's relationship with Sam's brother grows more serious.
Sam and Diane's new relationship together gets off to a shaky start, which comes as no surprise to anyone at the bar.
While Carla's in labor, her promiscuous sister goes on the prowl at Cheers.
Diane takes another job when Carla complains that she's getting special treatment.
Diane's efforts backfire when she allows an ex-con take the stage at Cheers.
Diane doesn't tell Sam that she is going out to dinner with her ex-fiancé Sumner and his wife, because she thinks he will embarrass her if he comes along.
Carla's new love interest could die from too much excitement.
Sam's newly divorced friend tries to come between him and Diane.
Coach sports an attitude when he coaches a little-league team.
Dick Cavett visits Cheers and suggests Sam publish his own writings.

Diane is furious, when she sees that Sam and her old school chum find each other very attractive.
Kramer includes Cheers in his will when he receives a dismal prognosis.
Carla shows up at her ex-husband's wedding with Sam as her date.
Sam questions Norm's abilities when he hires him as an accountant.
Diane and Sam try to get Coach out of their hair by arranging a double date.

Coach brings fortunes to Cheers when he buys an antique scale.
Diane forbids Sam to go on an annual ski trip with his buddies.

The recruits learn fundamental knife skills at Arirang Hibachi Steakhouse.
The chefs illustrate the importance of flavor with a "blank canvas."
The chefs teach their teams about the importance of multitasking.
Each chef teaches their two recruits a complicated dessert.

Chip and Jo tackle their first loft apartment in downtown Waco, TX.
Chip and Jo tackle a farmhouse for a family moving back to Waco, TX.
Chip and Jo turn a local restaurant into their dream breakfast spot.
Chip and Jo renovate a historic house for a musician and his family.
Chip and Jo walk through the castle, learn its history and plan its future.

Chip and Jo make last minute fixes in the castle's final construction days.
Chip and Jo debut the fully restored castle -- their biggest fixer yet.

Chip and Jo work on stunning design elements inside and outside.

programmes.t: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
programmes.d: This hilarious musical stars Robert Morse as a charming and scheming window washer who climbs to the top of the corporate ladder by way of a self-help book.

Spencer Tracy and Fredric March go toe-to-toe in this powerful recreation of a titanic courtroom battle in which an attorney faces off against a fundamentalist in a Tennessee town where a teacher has been brought to trial for teaching Darwinism.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

Eleven jurors are convinced that the defendant is guilty of murder. The twelfth has no doubt of his innocence. How can this one man steer the others toward the same conclusion? Henry Fonda and Lee J. Cobb lead the all-star cast in this classic!

Ernest Borgnine won a Best Actor Oscar for his role as a Bronx butcher who gives up on love, until he meets an equally lonely school teacher in this charming story that garnered a total of four Oscars including Best Picture.

George Eastman is a poor young man determined to win a place in society and the heart of a beautiful socialite (Elizabeth Taylor). Shelley Winters plays the factory girl whose dark secret threatens Eastman’s professional and romantic prospects.
Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

Elvis adopts an on-screen persona he knows well in real life-a singin' G.I. in West Germany. Eager to open a stateside nightclub after his hitch in khakis, he takes part in a wager to raise the dough he needs.
Maude begins to panic when she finds herself locked in a file closet with a highly incompatible person...her ex-husband Chester.
The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.

Alex tells Elaine that her hectic schedule of being a mother, a cabbie and a museum employee is driving her crazy and that she should see a psychiatrist. Elaine decides that a quicker cure would be to spend the night with Alex.
Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programmes.st: The Lighter Side Of Angela Matusa
programmes.d: The overweight blind date Alex once had returned to the scene a svelte shell of her former self, and eager for the romance she yearns for with Alex
Felix tries to reform after his finicky attitude towards food ruins an otherwise pleasant dinner with his ex-wife.

programmes.st: What Does A Naked Lady Say To You
programmes.d: Felix's new romantic interest is not the librarian he thinks she is.
Oscar's young niece, Martha, arrives at the apartment in an advanced state of pregnancy and tells her uncle she has run away from home because her parents object to her decision.
Felix selects a grave site and entrusts Oscar with the money for a down payment.
Uncle Joe tries to get rid of the pet chimp who is gradually wrecking the Shady Rest hotel.
Uncle Joe discovers that the 75th anniversary of the railroad between Hooterville & Pixley is approaching, and seeks to take control of the ceremony.

programmes.st: But I've Never Been in Erie, PA
programmes.d: An industrialist registers at the Shady Rest and offers Uncle Joe a chance to make a fortune.
Bobbie Jo attempts to soften up Billie's Jo's new boyfriend for marriage.
Ritchie adopts two baby ducks and Rob faces the task of making him understand the consequence of trying to keep pets that may be happier living in the wild.
To prove that a wife cannot always recognize her husband on the telephone, Rob disguises his voice and asks Laura on a date.
Rob recalls his and Laura's attempts to get married when Ritchie brings up the subject.
Rob is puzzled when he discovers Laura's secret bank account.
When Gomer's cousin Goober shows up in the barracks and puts on one of Gomer's uniforms and then wanders the base, everyone sees the name Pyle on the uniform and thinks Gomer is losing his mind.

programmes.st: A Groom for Sergeant Carter's Sister
programmes.d: Gomer starts dating Sergeant Carter's sister. Carter is determined to break them up.
Carter assigns Pyle to drive his precious car back from the airport but the car is stolen immediately. Now Pyle has 24 hours to find it before Carter gets back and kills him.
Gomer and his platoon engage in "war games" against a rival unit and Pvt. Pyle ends up captured and a prisoner of war.
Sergeant Carter orders Pyle to take a week long furlough but instead of going back home to Mayberry, Pyle takes a civilian job on base so he can remain close to the Sergeant.
Gomer's acts of kindness towards his new waitress friend is mistaken for romantic interest by her cruel Marine Sergeant boyfriend.

programmes.st: Two Nazis for the Price of One
programmes.d: A Gestapo officer who knows all about the Stalag 13 operation blackmails Hogan to find out about the Manhattan Project.

programmes.st: Is There a Doctor in the House?
programmes.d: Klink's illness causes problems for one of Hogan's plots.
The Allied Command orders Colonel Hogan to leave and turn over his operations to the bumbling Colonel Crittendon.
Newkirk sneaks a beautiful woman into camp who turns out to be a Gestapo agent.
Hogan convinces Klink and the Gestapo that the war is over so that they will release some prisoners.
Hogan helps Klink prepare for a hasty trip to Argentina when he finds himself in a duel.

While Lisa and Oliver consider what to do on their unplanned trip to Washington D.C., Mr. Haney rents their house to a family of eight. Meanwhile in the nation's capital, Lisa and Eb tour the White House, and Mr. Kimball makes official trouble.

When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

Farmhand Eb plans to take his girlfriend to a fancy restaurant for her birthday. Only problem is he can't afford it. Oliver encourages Eb to get creative and figure out how to earn the money himself. And if Eb is anything, it's creative.

Lisa becomes enchanted with the diary of a Lydia Plunkett. Found in an old trunk in the barn, the diary from 1898 tells Lydia's life story as a successful businesswoman. Eb and Lisa are glued to every page of the story, but Oliver isn't impressed.
Mannix is about to leave his office to meet a client one night when he receives a telephone call suggesting that he spend the night at home instead. As he exits his office, a shot is fired at him.

Against his better judgment, Mannix agrees to look into the case of a young man who twice robbed the same pharmacy seeking drugs. The second time, he shot one of the employees, but even though the police had the pharmacy staked out, he managed to escape.
Joe Mannix is invited to a party at the home of Phil Graves, with whom he served in the Army during the Korean War. Now Phil is a bank executive married to a wealthy socialite named Kathy.
When Mannix tries to find out what a disturbed little girl knows about her murdered doctor and $150,000 in stolen bonds, they both become marked for assassination.
Young Shelley Barrett tries to get to Barnaby, whom she believes is her father. She gets arrested on the way. Barnaby has to clear her, help her mother,and prove he is not the father.

J.R. investigates the disappearance of a real estate agent at a resort lodge run by two sisters and their aunt.. The murders pile up as he begins to realize that he's in the midst of a nest of scorpions with these women.
Barnaby and J.R. get involved in a kidnapping for ransom that goes bad and a former associate gets killed during the drop off -or so it appears.
Jedediah is set up on a phony rape charge and sets out to clear his name and find those responsible.

McGarrett and team investigate the murder of a former Japanese spy, an aged importer, believed to know the location of a hidden WW2 gold fortune. The killer may be searching for treasure before importer's son arrives from the mainland.

McGarrett watches with stunned realization as the state's rock-solid murder case against Islands racketeer Kum Chi suddenly vaporizes because McGarrett has been suckered by the prosecution's star witness.
McGarrett & Five-O investigate a deadly fire at Honolulu's Global Trade Center. Sub-standard materials caused the rapid spread. Targets: corrupt contractor & inspector taking bribes.
McGarrett & Five-O hunt for killers of a girl & hang-glider pilot. Slow progress until victim's roommate, burdened by guilt, risks life to aid McGarrett.

Three criminals plan to devastate the Hawaiian sugar cane industry by importing a borer moth with no known cure or natural predator. Their goal is to ruin the land, allowing one of them to purchase it at a low price.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Sparta Councilperson Harriet DeLong’s sister, Natalie, is found murdered, and Chief Gillespie has a suspect in mind, but it happens to be the most powerful man in town, so he’s keeping it quiet as he builds a case, much to the frustration of Tibbs.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Harriet DeLong is determined to bring her sister Natalie's killer to justice and decides to try handling things on her own. Meanwhile, the murder of Jay Turkus causes Gillespie and Tibbs to concentrate on V.J. Trundel and his devious staff.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: When an old friend and colleague apparently commits suicide, Virgil Tibbs travels to Philadelphia and uncovers corruption within the police force. Back in Sparta, Althea is close to giving birth, and Bubba is recruited to help with her Lamaze class.

programmes.t: In the Heat of the Night
programmes.d: Chief Gillespie travels to Philadelphia to help Virgil Tibbs, who was mistakenly arrested for the murder of a police officer who was helping him in his investigation. Together, Tibbs and Gillespie join forces to clear the name of Dwight Walker.

Steve assigns Amy Devlin and Taylor Lucas, two police officers from the Vice Squad, to assist in solving the homicide of local pimp Milton Wilder. However, Taylor convinces her partner to take a temporary detour on their way to the investigation.

programmes.st: Today Is The Last Day Of The Rest Of My Life
programmes.d: The new attending physician, Kate Delibe, is causing a stir at Community General with her unorthodox methods of care. Delibe assists terminally ill patient George Dugan's suicide against Dr. Sloan's wishes.
As Lou Summers heads to the comedy club to host Mark's Man of the Year Roast, a driver in a nearby car shoots at him and misses, but Lou doesn't hear it because his hearing aids aren't on.

Carlos is working undercover to get an elusive drug dealer known as El Vaquero. He's gained the confidence of his number two Johnny Primo. Walker wants them to bust Johnny and maybe he can lead them to El Vaquero.
Trent has gained a lot of notoriety of being a defender of abused women. Now the abused wife of a criminal turns to him for help. At the same, time Walker asks for her help to get her husband.
Walker tracks down crooked geneticists who have kidnapped an important scientist whose unique DNA is vital to their research in developing super-soldiers.
A woman whom Trivette knows comes to town saying she is looking for her father and asks for his help to find him. And when he brings her to him, she pulls a gun and kills him.
Mickey Rooney guests as former comic, turned bookmaker, whose troubles involved Richard Kimble.
Kimble hitches a ride with a local clergyman then suddenly, the cleric is killed by a sniper's bullet.
Kimble returns home and visits his sister Donna right under the nose of Gerard.
MacGyver and old buddy Jack Dalton are arrested and thrown into a labor camp, only to discover they are being used by the local authorities to search for some hidden bank robbery loot.
MacGyver and Nikki are trapped by old nemesis Murdoc and are forced to flee down the side of a sheer rock formation where an old friend of MacGyver's lost her life.
MacGyver comes to the aid of college student David Ryman, distraught over losing a Physics contest sponsored by David's father, a professor at MacGyver's alma mater.

Dr. Mark Sloan is caught between family and professional loyalties as his brother Stacy, and medical student Daniel, are both implicated in a mysterious series of events that end in an accidental death.
Steve responds to a call where earlier a man chased another man out of a store with a gun.
When Dr. Wesley, Dean of the medical school, is arrested for sale of narcotics, she pleads her innocence to Mark. Meanwhile, Mark's student Quinn and neighbor Jennifer plan to marry.
While out on his morning jog, Jesse unsuccessfully attempts to save a man who has locked himself in his gargage with the engine running, an apparent suicide.
Mr. Wilson hangs out and plays with Dennis and his friends for the day to gather information for a magazine article about the changing behaviors of children.
Mr. Wilson takes over an advice-to-the-lovelorn newspaper column for a few weeks, thinking he will have every single woman in town happily married by the time he finishes.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Sentenced To Happiness
programmes.d: The Andersons' gardener, Frank, gets a new job and ends up in court.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Mother Goes To School
programmes.d: Betty and Margaret end up in the same English class at college.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Indispensable Man
programmes.d: Bud is benched for the big game after breaking the coach's bedtime rule.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: Kathy's Big Chance
programmes.d: Kathy wins a contest to appear with Greer Garson at her latest film opening, but gets the chicken pox.

Bill entertains friends who are Japanese. The twins are interested in their culture. At the Japanese New Year celebration, the twins meet the grandfather and they tell him how fascinating he is. The grandfather gets a new lease on life.
Uncle Bill is working extra hours and the twins miss spending time with him. A co-worker suggests buying a fish tank and using that as a way to promote togetherness.
Bill is looking forward to a vacation, and Cissy is looking forward to her date with someone new. But the weather turns bad, and there is a blizzard. Everyone is kept at home.
Bill thinks living in the city is not good for the children, and considers moving to the country.

Mike thinks Greg wants to be an architect after reading Greg's school essay, but Greg doesn't want to hurt Mike's feelings and tell him the truth. Meanwhile, the other Brady kids also begin thinking about their future careers.

The kids give Alice the cold shoulder after they think she has broken their trust, so Alice decides to leave her job as housekeeper. However, the kids soon regret the decision after the new housekeeper teaches them a lesson.
Marcia thinks that a girl who is suddenly interested in Greg is actually using him so that Greg will vote for her as head cheerleader--over Marcia.

Peter tries out for the role of George Washington in a school play, but gets the role of Benedict Arnold instead. But he then wants to quit the play altogether when his classmates start branding him as a "traitor."
Marcia has a crush on her new dentist, which only intensifies when she mistakes an opportunity to babysit for him as a date with him to the ballet.

Bobby doesn't want to be safety monitor for his class because his classmates now hate him. However, he soon abuses his power and begins reporting on his family when they break house rules. Meanwhile, the family salvages an old sailboat.

Edith is all excited that she has been chosen for jury duty. When Archie realizes that she may be sequestered, he forbids her to be on the jury, wanting to keep her at home to cook and clean for him. When she is sequestered, Archie fends for himself.

programmes.st: Archie Is Worried About His Job
programmes.d: Archie stays up all night, expecting a phone call from a security guard who has information. It seems his company is laying off and he fears he may lose his job. No one else in the Bunker household can sleep either and it turns into a three ring circus.

Gloria has been reading books on women's lib and encourages Edith to try a little liberation. However, Mike won't take any of her ideas, which leads to huge fight in which Gloria demands that Mike recognize her as an equal partner in their marriage.

Archie is all set to go to the Mets game; however, Edith has different plans after she accepted an invitation to dinner with the Jeffersons. Archie discovers this and comes up with the excuse that Edith sprained her ankle, thus turns down the invitation.

Mike's artist friend, Szabo, is coming to the Bunker's house. Archie is a bit perplexed for two reasons. First, he is Hungarian. The other is that he sketches models in the nude. Szabo gets a great idea that Gloria should pose in the nude for him.

Archie is furious with his houseguest, Cousin Oscar. When they were kids, Oscar bullied Archie and now Oscar is taking full advantage of his visit at the Bunkers. Archie wants to throw him out, but Oscar makes an exit of his own when he turns up dead.

Mike and Gloria are all excited about their first wedding anniversary and order take-out as a special dinner. Sitting around the dinner table, an argument ensues which leads to Edith recalling the day Archie met Mike.

The family manages to collect $30 in the family pot and an argument ensues when Edith wants to use the money to set her lyrics for a song to music. Meanwhile, Archie is disturbed by robberies in the neighborhood and wants to use the money to buy a gun.
When Mama signs up for an open microphone night, another comedian steals all her jokes. She improvises by talking about her family, and the audience bursts out in laughter.
Mama finds an old certificate for 10 shares of stock, which is now worth enough to convene a shareholders' meeting of the company that is about to lay Vint off.
The heavy metal band that Bubba arranges for the homecoming dance turns out to be three girls. Their grandmother's cake recipe and the band are both a hit at the church carnival.
All's fair in love and war when Vint and Naomi get in an argument and Mama and Iola battle it out to grow the winning rose at this year's flower show.
When Mama slips on a roll of pennies in a bank, the family hires a shady lawyer. The attorney convinces Mama she's far more injured than she realizes and to sue for $3.2 million.
Mama gets a live Christmas goose, but the rest of the family is appalled at the thought of killing their new pet. In the end, Mama prepares everyone a vegetarian holiday meal.
When Vint wins a Mother's Day dinner for two, he must choose between taking Mama and Naomi. It turns into all-out family war, but Vint makes a decision that leaves everyone happy.
Mama puts everything she's learned through her love of old detective films to solve the case of Iola's missing mother.
When Mama and Iola make flyers for a single seniors' mixer, their photo is mistakenly replaced with a joke project for Bubba's photography class.

programmes.d: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programmes.d: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020's Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.
The Paris Opera Ballet performs the work choreographed by Rudolf Nureyev.

programmes.t: Beethoven: Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programmes.d: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37; pianist Maya Oganyan makes her solo debut with the orchestra.

programmes.t: Luisi conducts Paganini's Violin Concerto & Brahms
programmes.d: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of two great works.

The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programmes.t: Chamber music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programmes.d: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting a chamber music program consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.
Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, "Little Russian."

programmes.t: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programmes.d: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrates her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France; in this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians.

programmes.t: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programmes.d: Get swept away by the amazing visuals and premium sound quality of classical masterpieces! Watch breathtaking orchestral performances, operas, and ballets. Experience the grandest, most popular classical musical productions filmed around the world.

On February 2, 2010, two masked gunmen commit a violent robbery and shoot Michael Temple Jr., rendering him a quadriplegic for five years before his death. In this unusual cold case, DNA is used to create a sketch of the killer.

A police investigator discovers a letter written 16 years earlier that provides clues to a woman's murder. And a firearms expert supplies the evidence that South Carolina authorities need to put a man on trial in 2002 for a murder committed in 1961.
A mother is suspected in the murders of two of her daughters when her third daughter finally convinces police to reopen two cold cases.

With access to the San Francisco Police Department's work, including saliva samples taken from letters the infamous Zodiac Killer sent 30 years ago, we reevaluate the case of the serial killer who began terrorizing California in the late 1960s.

programmes.st: Gone in a New York Minute
programmes.d: In a city of eight million, landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006. Though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they spend the next nine years searching for answers.

When a 30-year-old mother fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL. Her family immediately suspects foul play. They embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

Nine years after the murders of a mother and her teenage daughters, a wiretapped conversation helps police to crack the case. And the baffling murder of a Virginia woman is solved when human bones are discovered by a geologist in North Carolina.

When a church deacon is found shot to death it looks like police may have stumbled upon a multi-party murder plot. And, a wife remains a key suspect in her husband's murder case for six years, until she attempts to prove her own innocence.

When 23-year-old Tonya McKinley is found brutally murdered on New Years Day 1985, a little boy is left motherless. A family must wait 35 years for advancements in forensic science to finally catch a killer using familial DNA.

It takes nine years and the work of cutting-edge forensic toxicologists to solve the murder of a medical examiner's wife. Then, a determined Alabama sheriff reopens the case of the deaths of two babies, hoping to get their mother to confess.
March 1984. Jack Kennedy discovers his daughters brutally murdered. Their mother and niece spend their lives keeping the case alive. DNA leads nowhere. 30 years later, an informant gives up a name.

New DNA technology and the national DNA databank help police hunt down a rapist-killer 11 years after he committed his crimes, and a detective's painstaking recreation of a woman's shooting death proves it wasn't an accident.

A killer authors a book about his con-man past that becomes the key to solving a 29-year-old cold case of two high school sweethearts--and three other cold case murders--leading police to believe he could be the Zodiac Killer.
In July 1997, the brutal murder of 19-year-old Tiffany Johnston rocks the small town of Bethany, Oklahoma. DNA points to her killer over a decade later and leads investigators across state lines.

Guns found dumped in a pond help police to solve the 15-year-old murder of Detroit cab company owner. And the rape and murder of an Atlanta TV station receptionist goes cold for 20 years before DNA links a man to the crime.
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but her sister Linda vows to solve her murder.

After 19 years, Kansas detectives reopen the case of a banker found beaten to death in his bed--and the chief suspect is his cheating wife. And a man with a guilty conscience helps Arkansas police to crack a cold case of murder.

Blake and Ders organize an early bachelor party to send off Adam after he's invited to be someone's wedding date.
After Alice deems Adam's past sales null and void, Blake and Ders fabricate fake leads to boost his spirits.
The guys accept a babysitting gig without realizing that Adam has dosed their smoothies with peyote.
In a flashback to 2008, the guys experience their first day at TelAmeriCorp and help Alice get a leg up at the company.
Luther, President Obama's anger translator, reminds everyone who killed Osama bin Laden.

Commitment looms for Jordan and Keegan after gay marriage is finally legalized.
Jordan and Keegan debate who is blacker, and Bobby McFerrin duels Michael Winslow.

Beavis & Butthead features two lunkheaded teenagers who dress in heavy-metal T-shirts, love stuff that is "cool," hate stuff that "sucks," and spend most of their time sitting on a couch making fun of music videos.

Nathan comes up with a way to sell alcohol to minors, helps an exterminator land a hotel contract and uses birds to draw customers to a car wash.
Nathan makes use of parody law to open up a coffee shop nearly identical to Starbucks in its branding and appearance.
Nathan comes up with a way to get a failing taxi company some much-needed press and implements a risky new line-cutting policy at a hot dog stand.

Sarah campaigns for fake mayoral candidate May Kadoody, and Steve asks Brian to consider marriage.

When Cartman finally stops bragging about his new Trapper Keeper, a stranger informs him that it will eventually take over the world and destroy humankind, if they don't destroy it first.
When Butters informs the fourth grader's that the Kindergarteners school play is a magnificent sight to behold, they go through a lot of pain to make sure they beat the tiny tots' show.
Cartman's family and friends have intervened and are forcing him to trim down. While Cartman's away, Kenny's star is on the rise when he gets his own reality TV show.
To get back at his parents for not letting him go to a concert, Kyle tells the police that his parents molested him. Soon, the whole town is free of adults and divided into two rival cities.
When Mr. Hankey skips Christmas, the boys find him living with his alcoholic wife and their three little nuggets. He tells them that no one is into Christmas anymore.
The you-know-what hits the fan 162 times when the citizens of South Park tune in to hear the word 'shit' on a popular TV show.
Big Gay Al returns to South Park as the new scout leader. When he is fired for being gay, the boys rally to his defense with the help of the new 'handi-capable' kid, Jimmy.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With 55 high caliber girls making it to finals, it's intimidating for the 30 veterans as they join the audition process & must fight to keep their place. Kitty Carter takes no prisoners as she prepares girls for their solos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As training camp begins with 43 ladies, the pressure starts to build!  Kelli's passion is infectious and intimidating in First Meeting, as she sets the expectations very high.  Seven girls will be cut to make a squad of 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Fear takes over for the new Training Camp Candidates as they face the reality of doing the DCC kick line & jump splits for the first time. Dreams come true if only temporarily, as the girls try on the uniform for the first time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: To be a DCC, you need to look like a DCC.  This week Kelli makes sure all the girls have the look.  The final rehearsal of the week brings emotions to the forefront as a girl gets sent home.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As the candidates enter the sixth week of training camp they need to start looking like a DCC or their spot is in jeopardy.  Melissa Rycroft and former DCC Tina Kalina sit in for Judy and give Kelli some fresh eyes.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With three girls left to cut and the first game around the corner, the pressure is intense as the girls return to AT&T Stadium to take the field for the first time since auditions.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The final day of training camp has everyone nervous because Kelli and Judy might take a squad of less than 36.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: This season 400 hundred girls that have dared to dream they can become a world-famous Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader, put it all on the line, as preliminary auditions for the 2015-2016 season begin.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Talent and looks alone won't get you on the squad.  Dreams are made and hopes are crushed as only 46 out of 59 candidates make it into Training Camp.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As Training Camp starts Kelli lays down the law.  Girls start to crack as the reality of how hard it is to become a DCC sets in.  Melissa Rycroft offers hope and advice on how to make it through.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli and Judy must cut 10 girls to get to the magic number of 36 for the squad. Uniform Fittings gives Kelli a better idea of who has the whole package.  As the cuts begin so does emotional end of dreams.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As the girls get the DCC look, it helps some and not others.  Two surprise guests stop by rehearsal and rock the DCC's world.  Kelli has one of the most awkward office visits of all time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Cameos and Show Group auditions push the new girls and vets to their limits. Melissa Rycroft tries to save a DCC that's hanging by a thread and there is a shocking outcome from a Kelli office visit.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Emotions are supercharged as Kelli & Judy make a lot of tough cuts to keep up the quality of the team.  Melissa Rycroft offers invaluable field experience.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli finally announces the squad. Injuries threaten the opening of Cowboys training camp.  Game Day chaos endangers a flawless performance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Hundreds of beautiful and talented hopefuls arrive to try out for the best cheerleading team in the world, while many of the returning girls are looking for redemption. New judges increase the pressure of moving on to Finals.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Veterans fight for their jobs as new girls try to live their dreams and make DCC Training Camp.  Standing in their way is; panel Interviews, solos, an exhausting dance combination and a room full of very tough judges.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The new candidates' eyes are opened as they get a taste of what it is to be a DCC.  As girls struggle to learn the dances, the reality of being "Big Time", sets in.  Melissa Rycroft meets the new girls for the first time.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With the first cut looming, the girls must push their dance skills to the limit. Melissa Rycroft works to bring out showmanship. Extra stress is added on Makeover day as the girls try to get the DCC look.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: A new choreographer shakes things up. The girls better start looking good because uniform fittings and the Belk fashion show are on the agenda.  Surprises continue when two-time Grammy winner Kacey Musgraves, stops by rehearsal.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Melissa Rycroft makes a house call to help Yuko.  Kitty Carter rocks a few of the candidate's worlds.  Cameos give Kelli & Judy a fresh perspective on the girls. At Show Group auditions, the girls let it all hang out.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kellie Pickler comes to a rehearsal to share her experience and motivate the girls as Training Camp is coming to an end. Melissa Rycroft makes Kelsey aware of a big mistake.  Candace Romo helps with a big night of cuts.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Squad announcement is bittersweet as some favorites go home.  The team has their first appearance at the Star Ribbon cutting.  Game Day is when dreams come true!

A beach boy involved with a gang member's sister is a suspect in his murder.
A surgeon (Wayne Rogers) drops dead while he's operating on another doctor (Jack Klugman).
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
A mad bomber whom Dr. Sloan helped put away has escaped and wants the good doctor blown away.
Steve becomes embroiled in political intrigue after the murder of a city councilman's wife appears to be part of a larger political strategy.
Mark investigates when her older lover, a new state Supreme Court Justice, murders a teenage girl.

A Malibu Hills fire is the backdrop for rising tensions between the residents; a disgraced stockbroker, a naturalist, a worried father, and a land developer. A worried Dr. Sloan deals with his own parental fears when Steve helps fight the fire.

Community General is already under increased security, with a high-profile criminal hospitalized, when an important businesswoman is brought in. Mark suspects her security guard has deadly intentions.
Jesse's new part-time job as a trainer of the pro basketball Mustangs turns deadly when he's accused of murdering a star player.
Dr. Sloan investigates a plastic surgeon when an actress's death apparently results from an infection contracted during surgery.
Mark and Amanda are assigned to the task force investigating an airplane crash. An adversarial FBI agent and Russian mobsters make their assignment more difficult.
Steve and Ron lead the chase for the stolen nuclear material.

The Sloans run into plenty of industry politics when they investigate the death of television network executive, Rachel Woodrall. Seamy revelations about Woodrall's college sorority lead to the killer.

The Doctor tries to make peace with reptilian Sea Devils persuaded by the Master to help him dominate man. With Jon Pertwee.
The Doctor discovers that the sea creatures are kin to the Silurians, a race he once helped destroy.
The Master devises equipment to contact the sea creatures and help them regain control of Earth.
The Master and the Sea Devils form an alliance.
The Doctor is brought before the chief Sea Devil and counsels peace.
Under duress, the Doctor helps the Master repair a unit that may revive Sea Devils globally.

The Doctor is sent to a skybase orbiting the planet of Solos in the 30th century, where he must deliver a sealed message pod; on the planet below, something is transforming the human population into hideous mutants.
Ky flees to the planet's poisonous surface, taking Jo with him; the Marshal, holding the Doctor captive, demands that he opens the message pod.
The Doctor gives the box to Ky, revealing the contents to be scrolls written in the language of the Old Ones.
The Doctor and Sondergaard make a discovery in the caves of Solos while Jo falls into the Marshal's trap.
The Doctor and Jo are once again sent into danger by the Time Lords when they are given a vital message capsule to deliver.
The Marshal is on trial, with the Doctor as chief witness; Jo and the Doctor's friends are the Marshal's prisoners.
The Master plans to seize the Crystal of Kronos, gaining power over time itself.
The Master manages to transmit the Lost City's High Priest through time into his laboratory.
The High Priest reveals that the Master has only a portion of the crystal that resides in the temple vaults.
Kronos attacks the Doctor.
The Doctor is transported to an eternity of nothingness, as the Master arrives in Atlantis.
The Master summons Kronos, but the creature is uncontrollable and causes an earthquake.
In search of the Doctor, an antimatter creature attacks UNIT and the Doctor is forced to send an SOS.
Following the advice of the First Doctor, the Third Doctor and Jo have crossed through the black hole.
The Doctors are trapped in the universe of antimatter.
Omega intends to escape his antimatter world and needs the Doctors to take his place.

The Doctor faces Drashigs.

Neither the humans nor the Draconians are willing to believe the Doctor.
Something is wrong with Castrovalva, but the Portreeve cannot help.
Accused of being spies, the Doctor is sentenced to imprisonment.

Nevada inmates learn how to train dogs to be adopted; an ex-show dog and his companion have a power struggle.
Cesar helps an adopted terrier mix overcome her terrible fear of men and attempts to solve a pit bull's unhealthy fascination with chewing on rocks.
A beagle has a chewing problem; three German shepherds must be kept apart; a bichon frisé dislikes her owner.
A Yorkie attacks his leash, plants and a fellow Yorkie; a bull terrier attacks larger dogs; a Jack Russell terrier/Italian greyhound mix barks constantly while her owner is at work.
Cesar tries to help Slick a fear-ridden dog who was rescued after living in a crate for 15 hours a day and Pepper, another rescue dog with issues.
Ava, a small mixed-breed spins constantly; Gus, a large dog who greets people by throwing its body at them.
Churchill is usually a well-mannered dog, but around other animals he's a monster, and lovable pit bull Maya can be a handful.
Cesar takes the spoiled Bubba down a notch; discover why German shepherd Garret never stops chasing his tail.
Emily, the pit bull, is sent to doggie boot camp because she is so quick to attack other dogs that her owners can no longer walk her.
A rescued mastiff likes to chew everything and barks incessantly; Paris is a temperamental, long-haired Chihuahua.
When Linda tries to walk Jake, he goes mad to protect her; Chantel wants to walk her 150-pound Rottweiler King.
Scrawny is the favorite dog in his household, but popularity has gone to his head; Lola the Dalmatian is spoiled.
A 12-year-old beagle mix displays unpredictable aggression; a couple tries to fit an aggressive puppy into their family.
Cesar helps Caper, a miniature Doberman rescue dog whose never been trained and Julius, a pit bull who is scared of everything.
A couple fear their border terrier is untrainable; an excitable English bulldog causes trouble for its owner.
An owner worries that her Doberman suffers from separation anxiety; a yellow lab has a problem with biting.
A wheelchair-bound owner wants to keep her German shepherd Shep in line; Sasha, the Lhasa apso, must learn who's boss.
Cesar helps a Rottweiler who has suffered a lifetime of abuse adjust to her new life after finally finding a loving home.
A terrier rescued via the Internet is a handful to manage and bites anyone who tries to touch his hindquarters; pit bull problems.
A family's German shepherd will only listen to one person; a Brittany spaniel becomes aggressive around female dogs.
A family deals with a stray dog who bites; Daisy Fuentes has trouble controlling her English bulldog.
A dog barks all the time and might pose a threat to children; a beagle mix has lots of strange behaviors.
A herding dog likes to bite the noses of horses; a family struggles with a dog who runs out the door as soon as it is opened.

Cesar has his hands full with a Labrador that is obsessed with water and a Chihuahua with a penchant for biting legs.
A human psychologist calls Cesar for help when her pet pug and pet pig fight; an emotionally scarred German shepherd.

After helping Sparky the horse feel better, Dora goes on one more ride with him before bringing him back to the barn.
Dora takes a magic cape back to the prince's castle so she can break the spell that turned the prince into a lion.
Dora and Boots return to the Snowy Forest to help the Snow Princess defeat the Ice Witch in a skating contest and win back everyone's ice skates.
It's time for the Rainforest Talent Show, but first Dora and Boots have to rescue Benny so he can tell his jokes in the show.

Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
Dr. Mike risks her life to battle a deadly diphtheria epidemic that threatens the town and her own family.
Tragedy hovers over Dr. Mike’s family, and Daniel falls seriously ill, as the diphtheria epidemic continues to rage.
Dr. Mike must judge her neighbors when litigation fever strikes Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike tries to mediate a treaty with the Indians despite the arrival of a famed Indian hater.

U.S. Marshall Elias Burch asks law-student Matthew to defend him when he’s accused of murder.
Michaela and Sully reminisce about the ups and downs of their relationship and make a momentous decision about their future.
Robert E vents his frustration over the death of his son and the demise of his marriage by stepping into the ring with a traveling boxing champion.
Dr. Mike’s elation at Colleen’s acceptance to medical school quickly turns to disappointment when colleen chooses to marry Andrew instead.
Byron Sully, an enigmatic man whose closest companions are the Indians and a wolf, becomes Mike's friend as she struggles for acceptance.

Blake mortgages the mansion to raise money; Tracy tells Alexis of her affair with Dex; Alexis is questioned about Mark's death; Sammy Jo intends to obtain custody of her son; an unknown woman, full of curiosity about Alexis, checks into La Mirage.

Kirby's attempt to kill Alexis is unsuccessful, and Alexis promises to remain silent if Kirby will leave Adam; Sammy Jo reveals the culprit behind Claudia's mystery calls; Fallon is gripped with a seizure and drives off as her wedding is about to begin.

Following a serious traffic accident, Fallon mysteriously vanishes. Dex and Steven bail Alexis out of jail. Sammy Jo attempts to seduce Adam. Alexis flatters Adam by suggesting he work with her defense attorney, Warren Ballard.

Steven accuses Adam of conspiring with Sammy Jo to kidnap Danny. Blake arranges to take out a mortgage on the mansion. He little suspects Alexis has signed the note and will become the owner if he defaults.

To secure financing for his bankrupt company, Blake arranges to see Billy Waite, a notoriously underhanded oil man. Jeff continues his search for Fallon. Impatient with the progress her lawyer is making on her defense, Alexis fires Warren Ballard.

In Seattle, Jeff and Blake learn the woman who died in the plane crash with Peter DeVilbis cannot be positively identified, but the ring she was wearing is indeed Fallon's wedding band. Back in Denver, Fallon's moving funeral is held.

Blake visits Dominique at La Mirage to discuss her recent revelation. She tells Blake that her mother was a long-time mistress of his father and has evidence to prove it. At Alexis' trial, a neighbor offers powerful evidence that incriminates Alexis.

On the witness stand, Steven testified he saw Alexis push Mark to his death. Jeff sees other women in an attempt to forget Fallon but remains obsessed with his ex-wife. Alexis takes the stand and testifies.

Adam and Dex vow to prove Alexis' innocence and begin a determined campaign. The woman who testified she had seen Alexis on the terrace with Mark had hosted a party that evening and snapped photographs.
Amanda insists Alexis acknowledge their relationship and begs her to reveal her father's identity. Alexis tells her it was simply an anonymous ski instructor in Gstaad. Steven and Alexis reconcile.
Blake offers to help Amanda find her father. Claudia goes out with Dean to dinner, while Steven rejects Luke. Jeff ends up sleeping with Nicole. Dominique goes to Istanbul to meet with Rashid Ahmed.

Krystle goes into premature labor and delivers a baby girl, who suffers from respiratory problems. She names the child Kristina after a friend who once saved her life. Claudia is uneasy when Steven accompanies Luke on a business trip.

Upon learning that he may be Amanda's father, Blake resolves to ask Amanda to take a blood test. Nicole tells Jeff there's a chance Peter DeVilbis may have been with another woman at the time of the crash.

Blake buys back his racehorse Allegre from owner Daniel Reece, who sends Krystle a gift. Furious, she demands to know how he dared approach her after what happened with her sister, Iris. Amanda learns she is Blake's daughter.

Krystle reconciles with Daniel, who reveals that his break-up with her sister was amicable. Claudia moves into La Mirage. Krystle confides to Steven that Daniel is Sammy Jo's father and therefore little Danny's grandfather.

Claudia rebuffs Steven's conciliatory attempts. Tension between Dex and Amanda continues to mount. On his deathbed, Tom Carrington makes amends with Blake, and in a final dramatic gesture, has his will changed.

Krystle begins working with Daniel. Blake is adamantly opposed and exchanges harsh words with Reece. Dex is furious with Alexis for traveling to Sumatra to see Blake's father. Alexis learns from Amanda about Dex's experience with Daniel in Vietnam.
A pregnant woman is kidnapped and held for ransom.
The team searches for an abducted newborn.
A missing boy is found after a hurricane only to turn up missing again when he is taken to a hospital overwhelmed with victims from the storm.
The team searches for a woman who was abducted from a parking lot.

A troubled Rigo must choose between abandoning the lucrative tour or headlining the tour to help rescue the man who possibly murdered his father; with his friend Poppy by his side, he turns the tables on Sage and Collette.

The Bishop and Lady Mae's crumbling marriage threatens to destroy the Greenleaf family, then a two-million dollar IRS tax bill arrives at Calvary, putting the church in danger.
Grace takes Rochelle up on her offer to help start a legal defense fund; Bishop and Lady Mae ask if parishioner Clara Jackson's Powerball winnings can assist with their IRS bill.
The Bishop sends Lady Mae into a tailspin when he surprises her with divorce papers; Grace gives a newspaper interview in Mae's place, while deploying Darius to investigate Rochelle.
Autumn dons a bold new look and is taught the rules of working a regular by The Trinity; Uncle Clifford learns of big changes coming to Chucalissa.
Mercedes and Autumn make major strides toward building new lives for themselves; gossip spreads like wildfire at the Pynk, and patrons flood in for a big night.
