Esta es la historia de amor de una mujer fuerte; Serafima, quien está en un triángulo amoroso. Durante veinte años, su rival y ella han amado al mismo hombre. Además de melodrama, también muestra la vida cotidiana. Un relato sobre la historia de Rusia a través de los ojos de una persona. El destino de Serafima refleja la historia de todo el país: desde la época soviética, la perestroika, hasta la época actual.

Sima queda embarazada de Víctor. Tras una pelea, él es herido y ella lo cuida. Irina, la chica que Víctor ama, descubre la verdad y lo deja. Víctor y Sima se casan, pero él solo espera el nacimiento del bebé.
El hijo de Sima nace con una grave enfermedad del corazón. Víctor la culpa. Sima busca ayuda médica en Moscú y conoce a una periodista que duda que un cirujano famoso la opere.
Irina y Víctor retoman su romance. Sima acude al cirujano Krasin por su hijo y termina salvándolo de un atentado. Agradecido, Krasin acepta operar al niño.

Police believe they've solved a mysterious death in Florida, but at trial the case takes a shocking turn, and a seemingly straight-forward case of murder by strangulation spirals into a bizarre crime story.
A man with a violent criminal history is imprisoned after he nearly kills his girlfriend; just months after he's released early on parole, he finds himself at the center of another tragic case.
Two strangers meet at a bar, but their evening ends with a gruesome death; police think they know who's to blame, but questions of motive leave them stumped.
One woman escapes the clutches of a New Jersey serial killer; the friends and family of another victim set a trap to deliver the killer to police.
Two elderly women in Los Angeles seem to pull off the perfect murder; when they try to pull it off again nearly six years later, things don't go as planned.
In Palm Bay, Fla., a seemingly innocent man is found guilty of murder and sentenced to life in prison; the strongest evidence against him is a debunked form of forensic science.

In 1973, the NYPD corners four young African Americans who planned to steal guns for the purpose of self-defense. Visionary police psychologist Harvey Schlossberg convinces his superiors to allow him to negotiate and save the 12 hostages.
Major League Baseball player Moe Berg lives a double life as a spy for the Office of Strategic Services during World War II.

Before he becomes world-famous mime Marcel Marceau, aspiring Jewish actor Marcel Mangel joins the French Resistance to save thousands of orphaned children from the Nazis.
One of the most famous cases in modern history ends with a verdict that shakes the nation; questions arise over who is responsible, and what part trial consultants and the media play in the outcome.

Facing 20 years in prison for firing a warning shot, a Florida woman is denied use of a controversial legal defense; learning what went wrong, and who "stand your ground" laws are really designed for.

A Wisconsin woman goes to a hospital hoping to confirm her pregnancy and get medical help, but she instead steps into a nightmare; after being held captive for several days and denied a lawyer, she is thrown in jail.
A California woman who claims she was acting in self-defense ends up in prison for murder; while there, she finds her story is much more common than she realizes.
A senseless double murder lands a California man on death row; despite the harsh sentence, a broken system surrounding the death penalty leaves everyone feeling that justice hasn't been served.
To rebel against her privileged background and family wealth, Rose Dugdale organizes the robbery of her family home.

On the night of April 26, 1974, Dugdale leads a raid on Russborough House to steal paintings kept in the Palladian mansion; under her instructions, the gang steals 19 works of art from old masters valued at around $90 million in present times.
The paintings are recovered and Dugdale is sentenced to prison.

Rodney Alcala flees Los Angeles in 1968 after the rape and attempted murder of an 8-year-old girl, but after moving to New York under an assumed name, he begins working at a New Hampshire arts camp for children.
After his early release in 1974 from prison, Rodney Alcala's victim count continues to rise as he uses his photography skills to prey on both young women and children.
In 1979 on Huntington Beach, Calif., a girl goes missing and is later found dead in a wooded area; the only lead is a sketch composite that resembles Alcala.
The first victim, Jeannie, is introduced through the testimony of her closest friends and family.
Experts explore whether there was a missed link made between Jeannie's murder and two more deaths.
The cold case investigation into air hostess Jeeta's death provides hope for the past victims.
The current investigation attempts to provide definitive answers for the grieving families.

This courtroom series stars former family court judge Judy Sheindlin. Each episode finds Judge Judy presiding over real small-claims cases inside a televised courtroom. Her no-nonsense, wisecracking approach has been unsuccessfully copied by other TV court judges.
Husbands battle over custody issues.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a woman sues her mobile-home neighbor over the sale of a mobility scooter and alleged harassment. He says that her repeated police reports ultimately led to his eviction. Next, an employer sues his former employee for quitting and failing to work off a sizable advanced payment. The worker claims it was a generous gesture, not a loan.

Following a collision between a woman's car and a 15-year-old boy at an intersection, the driver sues for damages caused to her vehicle and for emotional distress. Dashcam footage reveals the teenager's alleged involvement in a perilous, internet-inspired game of chicken.

Unwed parents sue each other for the $10K court maximum amid claims of assault, vandalism, and infidelity. With a second baby on the way, an alleged marriage-for-citizenship involving a Nigerian family member comes into play.
A man accuses his ex-girlfriend of stealing their pet corgi and breaking their lease. The ex claims she had to move out due to his abusive behavior and insists that the dog is hers.

A blended family sues their landlords after their lease is terminated, triggering a legal dispute involving allegations of harassment, false restraining orders, and property damage. A road rage incident ensues, with the former tenants claiming they were forced off the road and verbally attacked.

Two mothers sue each other for damages following a fight between their 11-year-old girls, who testify in court. The young victim, fearing for her safety, reveals she strategically positioned herself within view of a ring camera, aiming to capture evidence and ensure her mother's protection.
Car enthusiasts clash over an unpaid debt for prized car rims, a failed barter deal, and allegations of aggravated harassment.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after a brief relationship, a single mom sues her ex for payback of a $5K business loan. He insists they weren’t exclusive and that she knew he spent the money on his mother's funeral. Next, a woman claims the father of her children was violent at her baby shower. She says they were no longer intimate after the incident; he argues otherwise.

A woman sues her former friend, claiming that she only had $100 left to pay off on a car before it was repossessed. Countersuing for an assault, her ex-friend submits evidence of a mutually-violent altercation captured in a live-streaming video.

Two aspiring entrepreneurs from California accuse a man of failing to fulfill their order for custom t-shirts after full payment. The manufacturer claims mislabeled and allegedly 'unsellable' shirt issues are fixable.

Unwed parents battle over the right to claim their child as a tax deduction and contest ownership of shared property. Child protective services intervene to ensure the toddler's best interests are protected.

A driver burdened by parking tickets transfers ownership of his van to an unsuspecting friend to avoid paying fines. When he amasses more ticket violations, she repossesses the vehicle only to have it stolen; he sues for its return.

A man refuses to pay the adoption fee for a sick Labradoodle puppy, claiming that vet bills far outweigh the animal's value. He admits to giving the pup away when the seller did not retrieve it and that he already has 22 other dogs.
In this two-part episode, a woman loses her job after being accused of drugging and assaulting her colleague during an overnight business trip.

In part two, after allegations of gross misconduct on a business trip, co-workers battle for the court's maximum amount. Their dueling defamation charges hinge on conflicting recollections of that night.

A father seeks the court maximum of $10,000 from his 25-year-old son as reimbursement for bail and legal expenses following the son's arrest on Super Bowl Sunday for driving under the influence and carrying concealed weapons.

In part one of this two-part case, a young father sues his ex-fiancée for the $10K court maximum, claiming false assault charges led to a sweeping restraining order preventing him from seeing their children for two years.

In part two, ex-fiancées share conflicting narratives of violence, highlighting a chaotic Valentine's Day dispute that ends a week later with a young mother's hospital visit and competing police reports.

A family disagreement takes a drastic turn when a gun-wielding security-guard brother, citing self-defense, faces charges of domestic violence and assault after an altercation at their ailing grandfather's house.

The Judge rules on two cases. First, a barbershop owner accuses her former employee of breaching a non-compete agreement by launching a rival shop nearby, a mere three months after leaving her employment. Next, in search of discounted dental work, a couple flies to Colombia for a cosmetic procedure. They break up and proceed to fight over who should pay for the cost of their improved smiles.

Amidst an impending marriage, tensions escalate as a woman accuses her future stepdaughter of tire slashing and social media slander. While admitting to carrying a knife for safety, the stepdaughter counters with claims of an eviction, illegal lockout, and theft of her property.

In part one of this two-part case, a pharmacist takes legal action against his neighbor, alleging an unrelenting campaign of harassment involving police reports triggered by accusations of illegal drug use, drug dealing, and violent domestic disputes.
In part two, a longstanding neighbors' feud reaches new heights, leading to court appearances, protective orders, and a barrage of vulgar conduct captured on camera.

Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her former friend for $3,500, claiming the friend's unsupervised 5-year-old son destroyed her decade-old breast implants, stored in a sealed bag in her bedroom. In the second case, a dispute arises in a friends-with-benefits relationship as neighbors clash over a car loan and reimbursement for lost dresses.

Competing lawsuits ignite between a tenant and her landlord, fueled by the loss of subsidized housing, drug accusations, and an eviction. Claims of property damage and accusations of running a puppy farm come into play.

The $10,000 court maximum is at stake as an elderly landlord faces a terrifying arrest due to false accusations of gun possession. His tenants deny claiming that he aimed an AR-15 at them, while the landlord insists it was retaliation for his attempt to evict them.

Former friends sue each other for the $10K court limit, after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two. Claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment are further complicated by the fact that one defendant is now married to the plaintiff's ex-boyfriend.

A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement. He attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom. Concerns about the dogs' welfare arise when the Judge reviews a video of an online challenge where a slice of cheese is thrown on a dog's face.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home, which she had lived in since childhood. In the second case, a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI and installed a breathalyzer in the vehicle.

Teenagers fight over an unauthorized 3-minute joy ride that results in a blown engine and sizeable repair bill. Blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a reckless, high-speed freeway ride is introduced.
In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog. The dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

In this two-part episode, a woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant. Tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.

In part two, the conflict is reignited the next day when a knife is allegedly brandished, triggering a frantic struggle. In the chaos, the car sustains damage when the two parties engage in mutual combat ending in the arrest of both young men.

A 31st birthday getaway to Tillamook, Oregon, takes a dark turn when a woman sues former friends for an alleged assault during a drunken argument. What began as a celebration in a vacation rental with tequila and a hot tub, spirals into violence, leaving her beaten unconscious, and requiring ongoing eye care.

Emotions run high when a woman sues her ex-boyfriend for custody of their rescue dog, Luka, who makes an appearance in court. He alleges mistreatment of the pomsky by her teen grandson, citing incidents of physical discipline and even spraying hairspray in the dog's eyes.
A single mom from Vegas squares off against her dad's neighbor from Arizona over a disputed car deal. Conflicting stories emerge about whether they were more than friends.
A man sues a former friend for thousands in property damage after his window is shattered during a late-night confrontation involving an intoxicated girlfriend and a botched apology.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a 40-year-old man sues his 23-year-old half-brother over injuries sustained in a violent altercation, sparked by the younger sibling's attempt to jump out of a moving vehicle. In the second, a woman sues her niece for a Disney trip that fell apart after they mistakenly booked airline tickets to the wrong city in Florida.

A woman sues a former acquaintance for selling her a faulty 20-year-old BMW, which broke down days after purchase. In retaliation, the man vandalizes the car, claiming she still owes money. She accuses him of odometer fraud.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a man sues his ex-friend for negligence after two cats entrusted to his care go missing. He denies exacting revenge by maliciously redirecting his ex-friend's professional website to a pornographic site. Next, a vacation turns into a legal battle as friends sue their travelling companion, claiming she abandoned their planned trip to Brazil.

With the $10K court maximum on the line, a man accuses his former landlord of assault, claiming she attempted to stab him with a broken mirror during a heated altercation. The man allegedly refused to vacate the premises amidst a rent dispute.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, an ex-wife sues her former husband for the $10K court maximum, alleging his negligence led to the theft of her Jeep. Next, a home health aide sues her retired client, alleging unpaid wages due to the client's refusal to sign time cards. The retiree counters, alleging the aide provided subpar care.
A businessman accuses a seasoned racehorse trainer of reneging on a deal for a horse while she argues she returned the neglected animal due to undisclosed injuries.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a $190 loan between friends escalates into a $10K lawsuit, marked by alcohol-fueled threats and shocking voicemails. Next, in the wake of a friend's deadly motorcycle accident, a man leads police on his own 100mph helmet-less cycle chase through a quiet Ohio town. The aftermath includes a misdemeanor and a battle over legal fees.

During a move from Wisconsin to Minnesota, a family of six discovers their new rental home in utter disrepair, despite the landlord's claims of prior cleaning. They sue for the $10K court maximum, while the landlord, accused of wielding a handgun during the confrontation, countersues for online harassment and lost income.
A 26-year-old woman sues her mother for withholding her saved earnings, while the mother counters with claims of unpaid contributions to household expenses and damages caused by the daughter's cat.
A woman sues her ex-boyfriend over a jointly-owned car despite his generous gift of a replacement vehicle. A witness' blatant disrespect for the Judge leads to her swift removal from the courtroom.
In a marijuana-based business clash, a man sues a woman for withholding his CBD-infused ice cream equipment. She countersues for the $10K court maximum for defamation and CBD product retrieval.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman seeks custody of a shared husky from her ex-fiancé. He countersues, blaming her behavior for his loss of custody of his daughter from a previous relationship. In a related case, an ex-wife sues her ex-husband and his former fiancée for the $10K court maximum, alleging harassment, death threats and child abuse claims.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a mother takes legal action against her unemployed 19-year-old son over a jointly purchased car and multiple reckless driving tickets. Next, an Idaho ranch manager sues an 18-year-old Mustang trainer over the sale of two horses. She alleges that one of the horses was trampled and injured shortly after arriving at its new home.
A teenage girl accuses her former friend's brother of hurling bricks at her car, leading to significant damage. A misguided attempt to test loyalty with a lingerie photo comes into play.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a female artist sues her ex-boyfriend after losing a $4K commissioned painting, alleging his rambunctious kitten destroyed it. In the next case, custody of "Dumpling" the cat, hangs in the balance as ex-lovers fight over ownership and a GoFundMe campaign for the pet's surgery.

A man sues for the $10K court maximum after a woman crashes into his parked car, totaling it and pushing it onto the neighbor's lawn. The woman claims she was being chased by a hair stylist to whom she owed money.

Her Honor preside over two cases in this episode. In the first, a woman sues her ex-boyfriend over their shared truck, now solely in his possession. He counters, claiming child support payments eat up half of his paycheck and hinder his ability to pay her back. Next, a family feud erupts over a shared house, with a mother accused of stealing her estranged son's property and harboring his dog.

A woman's Yorkie is attacked by her neighbor's unleashed German Shepherd, raising questions about the defendant's claim that the dog is an emotional support animal. Video evidence captures the harrowing incident.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first, a man's motorcycle is repossessed after missing the first payment by only two days. He sues to retrieve his down payment sourced from a GoFundMe campaign after his apartment burnt down. In the second case, a social-media-inspired prank leads a woman to accuse a 10-year-old boy of damaging her front door.
The $10K court maximum is at stake when a woman sues her ex-boyfriend, alleging money owed and electronics stolen, despite his denial of their relationship.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, a man alleges a neighbor's negligence facilitated the theft of his car. He submits footage that not only captures the thieves in action, but exposes a crucial oversight by the neighbor. Next, an Atlanta man sues for a $1,200 Beyoncé ticket, demanding repayment from a former friend who failed to contribute to their New Orleans concert trip.
A woman sues an ex-friend for repayment of a $6K loan to kickstart a charity Bingo hall. Her ex-friend claims it was a philanthropic gesture from a Bingo influencer known for attracting big spenders.
In part one of this two-part episode, an Indiana woman seeks $9K in damages after she repossesses a car and faces grand theft auto charges when the vehicle is reported stolen.
In part two, a woman seeks thousands in pain and suffering after an ex-friend repossesses her car, sparking a contentious felony charge.

After hiring a stylist to do her twin daughters' hair for their sweet 16 party, a mother sues for $5K over alleged permanent scalp damage. Tensions escalate as the stylist countersues for defamation, and a litigant is thrown out of court.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, a homeowner sues a neighbor over vandalism by her 11-year-old son, who takes the stand in his own defense. In the next case, a novice driver faces a lawsuit for damages to a borrowed motorcycle after she wraps it around a tree and sustains severe injuries. She countersues for the $10K court maximum, citing the bike's alleged unsafe condition.
A retired LAPD police officer sues a comic book store owner for over $5K, accusing him of pilfering prized comics from his childhood collection that he planned to donate to a children's charity.

A man sues his ex-girlfriend's estranged husband, alleging he sabotaged a gifted car by putting sugar in its gas tank. The husband offers up a too-honest confession about spilled sugar but denies causing any real damage.

Two cousins sue each other for assault and vacation expenses. On a family trip to Dubai, a yacht party takes an unfortunate turn when one cousin's drunken behavior escalates into a physical confrontation in their hotel room.
In part one of this two-part episode, a woman sues for alleged vandalism, tire flattening, and defamation linked to her incarcerated ex-husband.
In part two, the defendant denies spreading rumors of felony charges and countersues for harassment. Incriminating video evidence comes into play.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a woman sues a dog grooming business owner in Texas for $10K, alleging negligence that caused permanent damage to her Maltese. Up next, after a couple's ill-advised decision to purchase a home together before marriage, a mother sues her son's ex-fiancée for repayment of mortgage foreclosure fees.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. In the first case, a woman files a $10K lawsuit against a man for falsely advertising for a female-only roommate. Allegations of harassment and retaliatory eviction come into play. In the second case, a young woman seeks $8K in payback from her ex-lover for a vehicle and damages from an alleged infidelity-fueled assault.
In part one of this two-part episode, tensions escalate between a married couple from rural Missouri and their neighbor, as they battle over noise pollution and harassment.
Part two delves into a neighborhood dispute in Missouri, exacerbated by a video depicting the neighbor's pet turkey causing mischief.
A Florida man sues his estranged wife's niece for over $6K for defamation due to a GoFundMe containing unsubstantiated claims of fraud.

A Florida woman sues a car wrap installer for a botched installation on her $45K Mercedes Benz, intended to attract rental business. She alleges the wrap began peeling off immediately, while the installer blames her choice of cheap materials.

After a pit bull encounter lands a woman in the hospital for four days, a legal battle ensues between neighbors over medical expenses. Despite the Judge's warnings about pit bull safety, the defendant vehemently denies all allegations.
In part one of this two-part episode, a Florida man sues his boss for $8K in unpaid wages and expenses related to her home staging business.
In part two, the plaintiff claims he worked 230 hours without pay and fronted his boss's expenses; she claims she never hired him.
A retired veteran turned entrepreneur sues a man over non-payment of an '81 Cadillac repair job. The caddy owner demands a refund, alleging deliberate destruction of the vehicle.

A Michigan teen, new to an Atlanta school, sues her 14-year-old classmate for $10K in physical and emotional damages after a violent altercation. A shocking video of the fight sheds light on conflicting accusations of bullying.
A man sues his ex-girlfriend and her daughter after a contentious argument over dinner etiquette and money escalates into allegations of assault and a false arrest.
A 17-year-old pedestrian suffers severe injuries after being hit by a motorcycle. The teen sues for maximum damages, while the biker disputes liability and seeks compensation for vehicle repairs.
A woman sues her sister after their chaotic pursuit to catch a cheating husband ends in a car crash and dueling damage claims.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, after spending seven days in jail following an alleged assault, a yoga instructor sues her ex-roommate for damages. Next, a woman hires a caterer for her 70th birthday party, only to be underwhelmed by the food. In court, the birthday girl sheds tears over the ordeal, despite the caterer's attempts at compensation.

Amidst a history of assault and custody disputes, a woman sues her ex-husband for $10K for harassment. He countersues for the same amount, alleging mental distress and accusations of kidnapping their son.

The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, a 19-year-old University of Texas student sues a fellow undergrad for damages after being hit by a car while riding an electric skateboard at night. Next, a young woman from Missouri sues a former friend to recover $600 bail reimbursement owed following the friend's arrest for speeding and drug possession during a road trip.
A singer sues for unpaid gig fees following a disagreement with the employer about her late arrival to his annual Spring party.

Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. Up first, a retired veteran demands the $10K court maximum from a neighbor due to an arrest for a DUI at a senior center. Next, a Missouri couple sues their former friend for trashing their remote cabin while he house-sat and looked after their dogs. They present video evidence of an unauthorized drunken guest he allowed to stay on the property.
Ex-lovers sue each other for the $10K court maximum: She alleges violence leading to a concussion, broken teeth, and permanent facial scars; he claims self-defense and a staged crime scene.

Both sides sue for the $10K court maximum when a woman suffers a heart attack after being hit in the face during a road rage incident. She is accused of spitting on and "potentially spreading COVID" to the young woman who attacked her.

Her Honor rules on two cases in this episode. In the first, when a woman bails her sister's car out of impound, she expects gratitude and repayment instead of alleged child endangerment and payback refusal. In the second case, a woman accuses her cousin of disguising himself with a wig, make-up and mask in order to use her Lyft account to earn money as a driver.
When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.
Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.
A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.
A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.
When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.
A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy

Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.
Gary y su hijo rescatan un viejo camión del ejército, pero conducirlo hasta la mina es brutal.
Garon y Josh pierden el control de Six Pack en los senderos embarrados.
Justin llega volando con una sierra de alambre nueva, pero pierde la calma al intentar configurarla.
El equipo encuentra innumerables problemas al tratar de cortar un trozo de la lente de 60 pies.
Claudia trae un gran equipo de perforación y tiene sólo cuatro días para encontrar el mejor jade, pero ella y Robin no pueden decidir dónde buscar.
Los chicos chocan cuando un empujón de finales de temporada los hace trabajar en dos minas a la vez.
El equipo quita rocas de jade de la lente J, pero un gran problema en la carretera amenaza todo.
Los malos frenos, los nervios agotados y un camino en mal estado hacen que Claudia dude que su equipo pueda transportar su enorme barraca hasta el campamento de una sola pieza.
Cuando la perforación de prueba de Claudia y Robin en busca de jade se queda vacía.
Un vendedor local de chatarra consigue hacer un ventajoso trato con Robin.
El equipo se esfuerza por subir el equipo pesado por un sendero de 120 kilómetros.
La tripulación intenta transportar su maquinaria a través de ríos crecientes.
Alan está convencido de que hay jade debajo de un pozo lleno de agua en su reclamo de Dinastía.
Robin trata de desafiar las leyes de la física con la construcción de una barraca gigantesca.
La mala suerte persigue a la tripulación de Jade City, y todos piensan soluciones distintas.
Después de una travesía difícil, Claudia y equipo de Robin llegan a la montaña Wolverine.
Robin y Alan comprueban si el jade extraído puede venderse en el mercado chino.
Claudia y su equipo hacen un llamamiento a Steve para que los ayude a salvar la temporada.
La temporada de Jade está a punto de terminar y parece que no van a alcanzar el objetivo.
Las heladas de invierno se están acercando y el equipo aún no ha dado con la veta de jade.
Las máquinas de Claudia y Robin comienzan a averiarse en el brutal trayecto hacia la mina.
La tripulación intenta cruzar ríos crecidos mientras marchan con sus máquinas hacia la mina.
Josh se queda varado en el largo sendero que conduce a la mina de Wolverine.
Guy y R2 luchan para conseguir cualquier gramo de jade y Alan les hace una propuesta.
Guy queda a cargo de Wolverine. Claudia y Robin establecen los objetivos de esta temporada.
Jay sufre un colapso que deja al descubierto las fallas de su preparación para emergencias.
Un arsenal de rocas sin valor impulsa a Claudia a considerar una nueva estrategia minera.
Alan lleva a un grupo de compradores a Jade City y el equipo de Claudia entra en pánico.
Josh corre el riesgo de perder 1 millón de dólares tratando de sacar su camión de un pozo.
El equipo encuentra la mejor roca de jade de la temporada, pero corre el riesgo de socavar su valor.
Justin, el hijo de Claudia, demuestra que tiene olfato para el jade.
Robin y Justin hacen una última búsqueda desesperada para ir a buscar rocas de jade.
Ciudad de Jade se ve amenazada cuando el tanque séptico retrocede hacia el agua potable.
La presión para el equipo aumenta: deben encontrar la pieza de jade antes del final de la temporada.
Con la roca más prometedora del año bajo las sierras de Wolverine, Josh y R2 chocan su camión.
El frío y la nieve ponen en peligro el intento del grupo por abandonar el campamento.
Claudia se ve obligada a conducir el camión de rocas mientras su equipo lucha por el sendero rocoso.
Los Bunce se esfuerzan para llegar a su campamento de jade en Wolverine.
Los Bunce montan un nuevo campamento minero con la esperanza de impresionar a sus socios.
La primera gran roca de la temporada se lleva al campamento y se coloca debajo de la sierra.
Justin se apresura a reclamar lo que le pertenece, luego de tropezar con un asombroso hallazgo.
Justin y el equipo se distraen intentando mover una gigantesca roca que podría valer una fortuna.
Después de discutir con sus socios de negocios, Claudia y Robin corren para reiniciar la minería.
El equipo se esfuerza por poner en marcha la cantera de jade de la dinastía.

programmes.d: Mexican amateur boxing is a high-energy display of relentless forward pressure and grit where fighters prioritize heavy body shots and non-stop action. It’s an electric, fast-paced environment where every young athlete fights with the raw passion and pride of a world champion.
I want to be an Entrepreneur walk through all of the challenges that entrepreneur face while they build their business.

The ONEFA is Mexico’s version of the NCAA, a high-octane collegiate league where the passion rivals the NFL and the atmosphere is pure electricity. It’s a world of 90-year-old blood feuds and stadium-shaking traditions that turn Saturdays into national events.

The Diablos Rojos Femenil are the reigning powerhouses of the Liga Mexicana de Softbol (LMS). Representing Mexico City, this squad has rapidly become the team to beat, blending high-octane offense with historic pitching performances.

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.

programmes.t: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programmes.d: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

Welcome to the ultimate pit. Metalcore Madness brings you the visual pulse of metalcore and deathcore—packed with blistering solos, heavy breakdowns, and raw energy. Turn it up, open the pit, and let the madness take over!

A cerebral explosion of technical wizardry and complex structures. Dive into a fusion of dizzying riffs, odd time signatures, and soaring melodies as masters of their craft redefine metal's limits in this experimental sound lab.

The sun is down, the filters are off, and the real chaos begins. Brace yourself for the raw, uncensored side of the scene too heavy for daylight. This is the unfiltered truth of the underground. Adult ears only.
A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!
Join Caractacus Potts and his magical, flying automobile for a trip to classic family fun!
This lavish musical is the story of a poor man whose love and faith help him face oppression.
Nicholas Nickleby sets off on an adventure to reunite his broken family in Dickens' beloved novel come to life
Liam Neeson stars as the legendary hero who refused to let his enemies destroy his honor.
John Hurt shines as a doomed rebel in this stunning film adaptation of George Orwell's classic novel.
In San Francisco, no one will hear you scream as alien pods duplicate you while you sleep.
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.
When Alex Murphy is critically injured, OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

programmes.t: To Live And Die In L.A.
programmes.d: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.
A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.
Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).
Author Truman Capote embarks upon a journey to write what will become the book of a lifetime.
Diane Keaton shines as a driven career woman who finds her life turned upside down when she “inherits” a baby.
Out of work, but needing cash to fund a surgery, Mitch and his pal use their only natural talent - revenge!
Funnymen Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal are a momma's boy and a writer who "agree" to swap murders!
Ruth (Roseanne Barr) doesn't just vow to get her husband back from a romance novelist (Meryl Streep).
Meryl Streep stars in one of the most visually and emotionally stunning love stories ever to grace the screen.

Bruce Willis stars as an imprisoned officer who refuses to give up his fight against the Nazis, even from behind enemy lines. With the help of a young lieutenant (Colin Farrell), he risks everything to free his men and change the outcome of the war!

With an all-star cast that includes Sean Connery, Anthony Hopkins, Laurence Olivier, Gene Hackman and Robert Redford, this epic WW II drama recreates Operation Market Garden, an ambitious plan to hasten the end of WW II that ended in disaster.

The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

When Cole (Franco Nero), a westerner trained in the deadly fighting rituals of Ninjitsu, is suddenly dragged into a dangerous dispute with an oil baron, he must face the best assassin money can buy, Ninja Hasegawa (martial arts legend Sho Kosugi)!

When a band of Ninja assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki (Sho Kosugi), he flees to America in the hope of building a new life. Osaki tries to escape his deadly past but soon discovers he has become the pawn of a ruthless drug trafficker.

Possessed by the spirit of a diabolical Ninja assassin and dominated by his relentless rage, a young, attractive woman sets out to brutally attack and destroy his enemies. Can her boyfriend and a martial arts master possibly save her soul?
Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.
Classic sci-fi adventure about a cop...part man...part machine...the future of law enforcement.
In this thrilling sequel, Robocop returns to fight his toughest opponent yet...his replacement!

When a greedy corporation starts evicting families in favor of a very profitable real estate project, RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins with a renegade band of freedom fighters to save them. But RoboCop must also face a new deadly android!
After the "Westworld" disaster, the Delos corporation is back, this time with "Futureworld!" But the resort might not be as safe as Delos claims…

In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell) controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

Burt Reynolds stars as a moonshiner who wages war against corrupt police officials in this action extravaganza full of epic car chases, bone-crunching brawls and terrific acting by a stellar cast that includes Ned Beatty, Diane Ladd and Bo Hopkins.

The Feds want Gator McKlusky (Burt Reynolds) to go undercover to expose local crime boss and former boyhood pal, Bama McCall. When Gator discovers Bama is involved in extortion, prostitution, and murder, the suspense builds to an explosive climax!

Feuding with Sheriff Lyle Wallace (Ernest Borgnine), Martin Penwald (Kris Kristofferson) unites scores of his fellow-drivers via Citizen Band radio into a mile-long convoy which, powered by pent-up resentments, rolls along the Arizona highways.

A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!
Billy Crystal and Gregory Hines have winning chemistry as two of the Windy City's finest (and wildest) cops, out to nail Chicago's toughest criminal.
Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!
The legendary Mario Bava directs this cult-classic tale of extra-terrestrial terror when an alien race targets a crew of unsuspecting astronauts.
When an evil troll attempts to forever erase mankind, a sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his plan.

Disguised as friendly country folk, a posse of people-eating trolls lures visitors to their town, and a family of four is about to discover this place is a real tourist trap. Now, the no-good gnomes must be destroyed before the family gets flambed.
The family that slays together stays together when six young travelers find themselves at the mercy of the eccentric Ma, Pa and their "children."
When a nine-year-old boy sees the ghost of a girl being murdered, he bravely sets out to solve the crime, but the killer may be closer than he knows!

Struggling actress Mary Steenburgen is offered the film role of a lifetime by the mysterious Roddy McDowall. But all is not as it seems and, as the pieces fall into place, her quest for stardom becomes a fight for survival in this twisty thriller.
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

James Brolin, Margot Kidder and Rod Steiger star in this horror classic as George and Kathy Lutz (Brolin, Kidder) buy their dream home only for it to becomes a hellish nightmare as satanic forces haunt them with sheer, unbridled evil!

The home of unspeakable evil is back! Tony Roberts, Tess Harper, Robert Joy, Candy Clark and Meg Ryan star in this third outing to Amityville in which a skeptical journalist sets out to debunk the Amityville house's reputation for unspeakable evil.

In this horror cult-classic, Vincent and his sister own the "Motel Hello," where they sell their delicious smoked meats made fresh on their farm. But something strange is going on over there. Folks are checking in...but no one is checking out!

Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.

In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

programmes.t: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
programmes.d: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!
Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!
It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!
Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil  presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.
In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.
Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

When a peaceful mission to move the Sioux to reservations turns into an ambitious general's vicious vendetta, a captain and his cavalry recruits are led towards a bloody fate. Written by Sam Peckinpah and starring Tom Tryon and Harve Presnell.
In this western, a man riding out for revenge against the man who killed his brother instead comes across the killer's own brother…who is blind.
Attempting to affect peace between his men and the Apaches, the commander of a fort unwittingly inspires an Indian massacre.
Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

Lee Marvin gives a spellbinding performance as Harry Spikes, a wounded outlaw who appears as a romantic figure to three impressionable youths (Gary Grimes, Ron Howard and Charles Martin Smith) and who he enlists them as his bank-robbing partners.

In this comedy western, Lee Marvin plays an ex-trail scout, and Oliver Reed is his half Native American partner who decide to settle accounts with a former partner who cheated them out of stolen money. But the partner has now joined high society!
Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun.

programmes.t: Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
programmes.d: Buffalo Bill has fought Indians & Civil War battles, but nothing can prepare him for show business! When he signs Sitting Bull for a role in his Wild West Show, the clash of cultures reverberates far beyond the boundaries of their sprawling theater.

Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

Screen legend Yul Brynner turns in a magnificent performance as a gunfighter who must do battle with his most formidable adversary - his own conscience - in this gripping, double-barreled western full of surprise twists and colorful villainy.

Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

In this thrilling follow-up to one of the greatest Western sagas in film history, notorious desperado Chris Adams (George Kennedy) is offered a huge reward to free a young Mexican revolutionary from prison…in the midst of the Mexican Revolution.

When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!
Audie Murphy plays a troubled saddle tramp with a penchant for drinking. After inheriting a ranch, he is led back into the arms of an old flame.

Seeking a fresh start, Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rolls into Dodge City with a chip on his shoulder and a gun on his hip. But soon, his mysterious past will catch up with him when an old friend calls in a favor...one that might cost him his life!

When the town marshal is gunned down, his wife Rose (Beverly Garland) dons his badge. But now an evil dancehall diva (Allison Hayes) wants her dead and hires a gunslinger (John Ireland), who agrees to kill Rose...until he falls in love with her!

Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

Mick Jagger makes his dynamic screen debut in this explosive tale based on the true-life story of the 19th-century Australian "Armored Bandit," who would become a mythic sagebrush hero even as the law closes in and prepares for an all-out war.

Twenty years after an unforgivable act, a pioneer has amassed immense wealth and a thriving mining town. But the blind ambition and greed that drove him to succeed finally catch up to him with the unexpected arrival of three apparent strangers.

Kevin Costner, Mary McDonnell and Graham Greene star is this masterpiece that took home 7 Academy Awards, including Best Picture. Sent to protect a U.S. outpost, Lt. John Dunbar (Costner) befriends those he was taught to fear, the Sioux Nation.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. Harley Rotbart, a nationally renowned infectious diseases specialist, pediatrician, parenting expert, speaker, and educator who discusses his latest book No Regrets Parenting: Turning Long Days and Short Years into Cherished Moments with Your Kids. He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

Why has infertility become so normal? Better yet – why are women the only one’s taking on the burden of infertility? The statistics on the amount of women struggling with PCOS (making them infertile) are only rising and with men being responsible for 50% of infertility, the conversation needs to change.

What if the key to a vibrant, healthy life lies in returning to our ancestral roots? In this episode of Rooted in Wellness, I’m joined by Dr. Darshan Shah who works to merge ancient healing practices with modern-day science to help his patients extend both their lifespan and more importantly, their healthspan.

Between work, family, and wellness, many women feel like they're running on empty. Mona shares empowering tools and mindset shifts to help women balance it all—without burning out. Fulfillment is possible when you root into what matters.

In this course, Anita Moorjani guides you toward loving yourself as if your life depends on it – because it does! When love (rather than fear) determines your life, you will recognize what is truly important for you to be happy and healthy.

Today, Anita shares what her near-death experience taught her about how to live. You’ll discover why everything we have learned through our education system, government, mass media, etc. is the exact opposite of what we should know in order to create a meaningful, joy-filled life.
Today, we take a close look at who we really are in order to recognize our purpose, understand our intentions, and recognize our true worth in this world.

We live in a fear-based world. In today’s lesson, Anita offers you tools that have been specially created to overcome your fears with love. This is the greatest lesson she learned during her near-death experience when she traveled to the other side. It’s the lesson that saved her life.

Today’s meditation will guide you through forgiveness. Of letting go of obstacles and fears that hold you back from living the life you desire to live. By doing so, you’ll be able to forgive everyone who has hurt you in this life, release emotional baggage that may be weighing heavy on you, and step into a new realm of possibility.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day one explores core teachings from A Course in Miracles: releasing ambition, ego, and grandiosity to become a compassionate presence. Rather than fixing or leading, we learn to hold space, trust divine guidance, and allow true healing and spiritual transmission to unfold.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day 2 of Teaching the Teachers explores the core teaching that only love is real and fear is illusion. Not a religion, the Course offers a non-dogmatic spiritual path that can complement other teachings and invites surrender to a higher power for true healing.

programmes.t: Teaching the Teachers with Marianne Williamson
programmes.d: Day Three of Teaching the Teachers reveals that the ego conceals our perfect, God-created Self. We are not our bodies, and life continues beyond birth and death. Thoughts create effects, yet through atonement we can be freed from guilt, fear, and suffering when we choose healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.
An ALS diagnosis changed everything. Aaron Lazar and Garry explore what health really means when life demands it.
Fear, fascia, and the body as a liquid crystal. Garry and Aaron Lazar go deep on alignment and transformation.
Healing is just the first step. Garry and Aaron Lazar explore what it looks like to move from surviving to performing.
Two months without a step. Garry works with Aaron Lazar through fear, fascia, and the power of belief to walk again.
Faith over evidence. Aaron Lazar and Garry explore what it takes to trust your body when everything feels broken.
Dried out fascia, frozen hips, and the fear of moving forward. Garry works with Aaron Lazar to restore the flow.
Pain is a signal, not a sentence. Garry and Aaron Lazar challenge what medical labels do to the body's ability to heal.
How shame, fear, and cancel culture block spiritual ascension and why true transformation requires death before rebirth.
How identity-first change breaks loops of anxiety, addiction, and disease and why placebo beats diagnosis when you understand the hidden operating system of health.

Lisa Garr talks with Dr. Dain Heer, co-founder of Access Consciousness. Many of us suffer from a feeling of having to please others or conform to outside pressures. He shares his ideas on how to live authentically & his new book “Body Whispering.”

Lisa Garr talks with anti-aging experts Debra Poneman and Ronnie Newman about the importance of lowering stress for health and vitality. They also share simple meditation exercises and healthy recipes.

Lisa Garr talks with expert numerologist Glynis McCants. Known as “The Numbers Lady,” she talks about the history of Numerology as a numbers system and as a science used by Pythagoras forward. She explains about your life path & your personal year.

Lisa Garr talks with Nadine Artemis, founder of natural skin care company Living Libations, about how most “natural” beauty products contain traces of chemicals. Artemis believes that each plant has a certain vibration which can be used in healing.

Lisa Garr talks with author and spiritual teacher Sadhvi Bhagawati Saraswati about knowing when to trust a deep, inner calling. She was completing her Ph.D. at Stanford when she left America to live in India, where she has been for over 25 years.

Your day 5 practice introduces principles of stability or Sthira. Though this practice we learn to to steady the mind as we strengthen the body. Build on yesterday’s practice to marry effort with ease. Invite your breath to be smooth and even as we continue to build on your foundation.

Your day 6 practice invites you to use core work to get clear. In this session we use controlled movement to activate the muscles of the abdominal for a strong and healthy back and strengthen your whole self.

Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

Founder, Glenn Marsden, of Imperfectly Perfect Campaign, and Jeremy Jackson, former Baywatch star share their personal journeys with body dysmorphia and how it led to a worldwide campaign. A young man faces his fears and a tale of kindness at 30,000 ft.

Laura Di Franco, CEO of Brave Healer Productions, discusses brave healing and the power of sharing our stories. And, meet Oyen the ginger cat and adorable kids from India, along with Daaji redefining meditation for a joyful heart.

Join The Kitchen Psychic, Hannah McKitrick, as we talk ditching diets, embracing food freedom, and finding lightness in mind and body, alongside Susan Noles from The Golden Bachelor for some fun, and meditation leader Daaji discussing compassion.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.
Suffering has deep social causes. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains how your physiology is impacted by stress and social determinants.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Day 1 welcomes you to Desire Mapping—an approach to living guided by how you want to feel, not just what you want to do. By shifting from goal lists to heart-centered intention, this introduction invites you to honor presence, intuition, and the feelings that shape a fulfilling life.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Desire Mapping guides you to live from the heart, focusing on how you want to feel rather than just what you want to do. Through practices like Soul Limber, appreciation, attention management, Core Desired Feelings, and exploring your inner selves, you gain clarity, agency, joy, and purpose in creating a fulfilling life.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Set down your Core Desired Feelings and explore the words that shape your inner world. This practice reveals patterns, clarifies your choices, and turns intention into living energy. Your feelings and words become a beacon, guiding you to live from the heart with focus and purpose.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Step into Intentional Creation using your Core Desired Feelings as your guide. Align actions with heart-centered intentions, release what no longer serves you, and transform your goals into sacred desires. Cultivate agency, joy, and flow as your inner world shapes your outer reality.

programmes.t: The Desire Map Course with Danielle LaPorte
programmes.d: Integrate your Core Desired Feelings through daily practice, reflection, and heart-centered rituals. Using mindfulness, breath, and prayer, cultivate sacred connection, peace, and purpose. Return to your heart each day, and let your love and clarity ripple into the world.
